en: Ellen, I'd like your opinion.
About what?
Well, Richard and I feel that with a baby coming,
cn: 嗯，Richard 和我觉得有了宝宝之后

en: we need to have our own place to live.
cn: 我们需要有自己的地方住。

en: Well, what do you think about Richard and me looking for a small house
or an apartment at this point in our lives?
cn: 去找个小房子或公寓怎么样？

en: We love having you here.
cn: 我们很喜欢你住在这儿，

en: And there is room, and when the baby comes,
the baby can stay in your room for a while.
cn: 宝宝可以暂时住你房间。

en: Richard feels we need to find a small house.
cn: Richard 觉得我们需要找一栋小房子。

en: I remember when I was pregnant with Richard.
Philip and I were living with Grandma and Grandpa.
cn: Philip 和我当时跟爷爷奶奶住在一起。

en: Philip was a young doctor,
and he kept talking about having a house of our own.
cn: 他总念叨着要拥有自己的房子。

en: It's natural.
What did you do?
We looked at a lot of houses.
Did you find one?
Not at first, but we couldn't afford it.
Grandpa wanted to lend us the money to buy one.
But Philip is too independent.
He didn't want to borrow any money.
Sounds like Richard.
Well, they're all alike.
Richard is a real steward.
cn: Richard 是个十足的 Stewart 家的人。

en: He's independent and sometimes just stubborn.
When did you buy a house?
cn: 你们什么时候买的房子？

en: After Richard was born.
He was teaching music, and Philip was opening his first medical office.
cn: Philip 也刚开他的第一个诊所。

en: Where was the house?
Right here in Riverdale.
Of course, it was a small house, but just right for us.
It's funny. History repeats itself.
cn: 真有趣，历史总是惊人的相似。

en: Now, Richard and I are having a baby,
cn: 现在 Richard 和我有了宝宝，

en: and we probably won't be able to afford a house right away either.
Why don't you look at some houses, Marilyn?
cn: Marilyn，你们不如去看看一些房子？

en: Good idea.
Look in the real estate section of Sunday's Times.
cn: 翻翻《周日泰晤士报》的房地产版。

en: You'll learn a lot.
Maybe we should speak to a real estate agent about a house.
And a bank about a mortgage?
cn: 找房地产经纪人聊聊房子的事。

en: I'll talk to Richard about it.
cn: 再找银行问问抵押贷款。

en: I think it's a good idea, Ellen.
We can learn a lot by asking.
And if I can be of any help, let me know.
As a matter of fact,
my friend Virginia Martinelli is a real estate agent.
Good.
I don't believe this, but she sold us our first house and this one.
cn: 我们的第一栋房子和这栋都是她卖给我们的。

en: I'll tell Richard, and we'll go to see her.
Do you think the skirt length is right, Ellen?
cn: Ellen，你觉得裙子长度合适吗？

en: Do you think it's too long?
I think the skirt is just right.
cn: 我觉得裙子长度刚刚好。

en: Are you planning to attach a train to it?
No. No train. Just the dress.
cn: 不，不要裙拖。就是这条裙子。

en: But I am going to make a headpiece of lace.
cn: 不过我会做一个蕾丝头饰。

en: That dress is gorgeous.
Thanks, Ellen.
And thanks for the advice about the house.
cn: 也谢谢你关于房子的建议。

en: I'll talk to Richard about it the minute he comes home.
And remember, we love having you here.
cn: 我们很喜欢你住在这儿。

en: There's no need to rush.
I remember your parents' first house very well.
It was on Spring Avenue near the park.
cn: 在 Spring 大道，公园附近。

en: I grew up in that house.
cn: 我就是在那栋房子里长大的。

en: Yes, and you were such a cute baby.
cn: 是的，你当时是个特别可爱的宝宝。

en: I've seen pictures of him. He had blond hair.
I've been friendly with the Stewart family for a long time,
cn: 我和 Stewart 一家交情

en: so it's my pleasure to help you find a house now.
cn: 能帮你们找房子是我的荣幸。

en: Well, we're not sure we can afford one.
cn: 嗯，我们不太确定能不能买得起。

en: But we'd like to find out about the possibilities,
and that's a good idea.
I love your house on Linden Street.
cn: 我喜欢你们林登街的房子。

en: I sold your father that house 17 years ago.
cn: 十七年前我把那栋房子卖给你父亲的。

en: Really? Yes.
Mom was pregnant with Robbie then, and they needed the extra room.
I hear you're expecting a baby, Mrs. Stewart.
cn: 听说您要有宝宝了，Stewart 太太。

en: Mm-hmm. So we will be needing more room.
cn: 所以我们以后会需要更多空间。

en: Oh, so you don't need something immediately?
No, but in five or six months.
And time passes so quickly.
Yes, it does.
Well, when you called, you gave me enough information
about your salaries and your savings,
cn: 你们的工资和存款情况。

en: so I have a good idea about your financial situation.
cn: 所以我对您的财务状况有大概了解。

en: Let me show you some pictures of houses with two bedrooms.
cn: 我给您看一些房子的照片。

en: Yes, I think I can show you some.
cn: 是的，我想我能给您看一些。

en: Of course, they won't be in Riverdale.
The cost of housing's too high for you here.
cn: 这边的房价对您来说太高了。

en: I haven't thought about living anywhere else.
We've always lived in this area.
cn: 我们一直住在这个地区。

en: Where should we look for a house, Mrs. Martinelli?
cn: 我们该去哪儿找房子，Martinelli 太太？

en: Well, we have an office in Mount Kisco.
cn: 嗯，我们在 Mount Kisco 有个办事处。

en: It's a lovely area, and it's only about an hour's drive from here.
cn: 从这儿开车只要一小时。

en: Here, I have a book with photos of some homes in that area.
Now, let's see.
Here, this is a lovely two-bedroom house in your price range.
cn: 这是栋可爱的两居室，在您的预算范围内。

en: It's pretty, but I prefer a two-story home.
cn: 但我更喜欢两层的房子。

en: I do, too. I don't care for a ranch type.
Okay. Oh, this is a wonderful house.
I know it well. I sold it to the present owners.
cn: 我把它卖给了现在的房主。

en: It looks wonderful.
This is a two-bedroom, two-bath house.
cn: 这是两居室、两卫的房子。

en: It has a full basement, and it is on a half-acre lot.
You can probably afford this one.
Mmm. I like this house.
So do I.
And the price is right. Would you like to go see it?
Yes. We're planning to talk to someone at the bank next week.
cn: 下周去跟银行的人谈谈。

en: Perhaps we could see the house this weekend.
cn: 也许这个周末我们可以去看看房子。

en: If someone doesn't buy it before then.
cn: 如果在那之前没人买走的话。

en: But let's keep looking just to get an idea of some other possibilities.
cn: 只是了解一下其他可能。

en: This is very helpful, Mrs. Martinelli.
Here, this is a wonderful example of a Spanish-style architecture.
cn: 这是西班牙风格建筑的绝佳范例。

en: Oh, I love the roof tiles on a Spanish-style house.
cn: 我喜欢西班牙风格房子上的屋顶瓦。

en: It looks like the house is in Hollywood.
cn: 看起来像好莱坞的房子。

en: It's interesting. A house like this in Riverdale costs double the price.
cn: 在 Riverdale，这样的房子价格要翻倍。

en: Here's a real buy.
It's a bargain. This house just came on the market.
It's quite lovely. Is it a two-bedroom house?
No. It has three bedrooms and three baths.
I know the house. It has a brand-new kitchen
and a living room with a 12-foot ceiling.
cn: 客厅有十二英尺的挑高天花板。

en: And there's a two-car garage.
Then why don't we go look at this house, too?
cn: 那我们不如也去看看这栋？

en: It's a good investment.
Thank you, Mrs. Martinelli.
Thanks so much. My pleasure.
Give my best to your parents.
Your father's a wonderful doctor, Richard.
cn: 你父亲是位出色的医生，Richard。

en: He took care of my daughter when she was a child.
He's the best pediatrician in Westchester.
cn: 他是 Westchester 最好的儿科医生。

en: Thanks, Mrs. Martinelli. I'll give them your regards.
We really appreciate your advice.
I do think you should go see the houses and talk to the bank.
cn: 我真的觉得你们应该去看看房子，

en: Here, let me give you some information about the houses.
cn: 我给您一些这些房子的资料。

en: They're both very goodbyes.
Well, thanks so much for your help and your time, Mrs. Martinelli.
cn: 嗯，非常感谢您的帮助和时间，

en: We've got a lot to talk about.
Mm-hmm. Thanks.
I'm Richard Stewart, and this is my wife, Marilyn.
cn: 我是 Richard Stewart，这是我妻子 Marilyn。

en: Pleased to meet you. Likewise, Mr. Riley.
Please. Sit down. What can I do for you?
cn: 请坐。我能为你们做什么？

en: We'd like to discuss a mortgage.
cn: 我们想咨询一下抵押贷款。

en: For a house. Fine.
Are you buying a house or are you refinancing your present home?
cn: 还是为现在的房子重新融资？

en: We're planning to buy a house.
And we'd like to find out about a mortgage.
cn: 我们想了解一下抵押贷款。

en: We are customers at the bank.
As a matter of fact, my whole family bank's here.
cn: 事实上，我们全家都在这家银行开户。

en: I have some questions to ask.
Do you own your house or do you rent?
cn: 你们是自有住房还是租房？

en: Neither. We live with my parents, Dr. and Mrs. Phillip Stewart.
cn: 我们和我父母住在一起，Philip Stewart 医生夫妇。

en: And how old are you?
And Mr. Stewart, what is your occupation?
cn: Stewart 先生，您的职业是什么？

en: I'm a freelance photographer.
And Mrs. Stewart, are you working?
Yes, I'm a designer. And I work in a boutique.
cn: 是的。我是设计师，在一家精品店工作。

en: Did you bring any savings or salary information?
cn: 你们带存款或工资证明了吗？

en: Last year's tax forms? Yes.
Here they are.
What kind of house did you have in mind?
cn: 好的。你们……你们想买什么样的房子？

en: Well, we're talking about buying a two-bedroom house in Mount Kisco.
cn: 在 Mount Kisco 买一栋两居室。

en: Here are the financial details on the house.
Thank you. Are you prepared to make a 10% down payment?
cn: 你们准备付一成首付吗？

en: Yes, we are.
Payment's over 30 years? Yes.
Do you think we can get a loan?
cn: 您觉得我们能拿到贷款吗？

en: Well, it depends.
Do you own any other property?
cn: 嗯，要看情况。你们有其他不动产吗？

en: Any stocks or bonds?
No.
Perhaps you could get a guarantor.
cn: 也许您可以找一位担保人——

en: Someone to sign for the loan for you?
cn: 就是有人为你们的贷款签字担保。

en: Why is that necessary?
Since you don't have enough income and you don't already own any property,
the bank needs to be sure you can pay the mortgage every month.
A guarantor is responsible for the loan if you can't make the payments.
cn: 担保人在你们还不上时

en: I see.
Well, the idea of buying a house is exciting.
cn: 我明白了。买房的想法令人兴奋。

en: Thank you, Mr. Riley. We'll read this over carefully.
cn: 谢谢您，Riley 先生。我们会仔细阅读这些。

en: Thank you.
Goodbye. Thanks.
Goodbye. And hope to see you soon?
I hope so too.
Take care.
It all sounded so easy until they mentioned needing collateral or a guarantor.
cn: 直到他们提到需要抵押品或担保人。

en: We have no collateral.
And I don't think it's a good idea to ask Dad to sign as a guarantor.
cn: 让爸爸做担保人签字不太好。

en: I don't feel right about it.
I understand your feelings about it, Richard.
Now tell me. What's the problem?
We can get a loan from the bank if we can put up some collateral.
Then we don't own anything to use as collateral.
cn: 但我们没有任何东西可以作抵押。

en: Or someone can sign with us as a guarantor.
cn: 或者有人可以和我们一起签字做担保人。

en: Why don't you speak to Dad?
No. If we buy a house, I want to be able to handle it alone.
cn: 不。如果买房，我想自己能搞定。

en: Everybody needs help sometimes, Richard.
cn: 每个人有时都需要帮助，Richard。

en: I understand Richard's feelings about it, Ellen.
In two or three months, I'll have an advance on my book and be able to put more money down.
cn: 两三个月后，我会拿到书的预付款，

en: What about the house in Mount Kisco? Somebody else will buy it by then.
cn: Mount Kisco 那栋房子怎么办？

en: Then there'll be other houses, Marilyn.
Oh, Richard has a point. You're just beginning to look.
cn: Richard 说得有道理。你们才刚开始看。

en: We're in no great rush. It's true.
This has been a great learning experience for us, Marilyn.
cn: 这对我们是一次很好的学习经历，Marilyn。

en: Talking to the real estate agent, looking at the houses,
talking to the loan officer at the bank.
It has been a learning experience. That's true.
cn: 确实是次学习经历。没错。

en: I think you're doing the right thing.
cn: 我觉得你们做得对。慢慢来。

en: Taking your time, looking around, especially with the purchase of this kind.
cn: 多看看。尤其这种大额购买。

en: You're talking about a lot of money.
cn: 你们说的可是一大笔钱。

en: We'll call Mrs. Martinelli and tell her to keep looking for us.
cn: 我们会给 Martinelli 太太打电话，让她继续帮我们留意。

en: And I'll call Mr. Riley at the bank and tell him we'll see him in a couple of months.
cn: 告诉他我们过两个月再找他。

en: And if you ever need that or me to help you...
cn: 如果你们需要爸爸或我帮忙……

en: We know.
You know we'll be there for you.
It's a steward tradition. We're a family.
cn: 这是 Stewart 家的传统。我们是一家人。
